title: Architecture hard-fail and package generators
summary: Structure architecture rules now hard-fail in CI, and developers can scaffold new module and plugin packages with Artisan generators without editing Core.
changes: Architecture dependency tests hard-fail in CI: Core must not import Modules or Plugins; plugins use only declared dependencies via public API; modules must not import other modules.
Added php artisan make:module and make:plugin stubs with a developer guide so new packages register without editing app/Core.
Documented Structure as shipped in AGENTS.md (ship order 7 → 9 → 8 → 5) and updated architecture docs for the hard-fail suite.
Moved the shared record-owner validation rule into App\Rules so Cases does not import Tickets rules.
affected_areas: Artisan make:module / make:plugin generators and stubs
Developer guide and agent new-plugin skill
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.37.x Structure line: hardens architecture enforcement and adds developer tooling without changing live URLs or permission strings.
validation: Focused PHPUnit: Architecture suite, StructureGeneratorsWave8Test, Wave 6/7 structure suites
known_limitations: Generated packages still need a routes/web.php require and module.php plugins list entry to appear in live navigation.
UI glossary wording for Core / Module / Plugin remains with #267.
rollback: Redeploy the previous Cloudron package (0.37.10). No database migrations ship in this release.
provenance: Structure Wave 8 for issues #294 and #295; pull request #311.
